question: If an opponent copies a spell with demonstrate, does their copy go on top of the stack?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you choose an opponent immediately, and if they copy it, their copy goes on top of the stack.
expected.answer: If you copy a spell with demonstrate, you then immediately choose an opponent. If they copy the spell, it goes on top of the stack.
